label: Chat that compacts its history
description: A chat agent with session-based Chat Memory v2 and a small turn window, so older turns are compacted, plus conversation search to recall anything from the full log.

triggers.description: Starts a run each time a user sends a message in the chat. It provides the message text and the conversation ID used by the memory.
triggers.name: chat_1
triggers.label: New Chat Request

tasks.description: A friendly chat assistant. It sees only the last few turns. If the user asks about something said earlier, it searches the full conversation log first.
tasks.name: aiAgent_1

parameters.systemPrompt: You are a friendly assistant. Your visible history is short. If the user asks about something said earlier that you no longer see, use the conversation search tool to find it, and say that you searched.

model.description: The Claude model the assistant answers with. Needs an Anthropic connection.
model.name: anthropic_1

chatMemory.description: Session memory (Chat Memory v2) keyed by conversation ID. Only the last 3 turns go to the model, and conversation search lets the agent look up anything in the full log.
chatMemory.name: chatMemory_1

model.description: A smaller Claude model (Haiku) that the chat memory uses for its own work on the history, keeping that cost off the main model.
model.name: anthropic_2

tasks.label: AI Agent

tasks.description: Sends the assistant's answer back to the user in the chat.
tasks.name: reply_1
tasks.label: Reply
